hypothesis: Magnetic horizontal-gradient ridges of the RTP anomaly that lie at least 400 m from every mapped fault mark unmapped, fault-controlled magnetic contacts.
mechanism: Lateral magnetisation contrasts along faults produce gradient maxima; excluding catalogue-adjacent ridges targets faults that the catalogue does not contain.
named_nonfault_mimic: Lithologic magnetic contacts (intrusive or sedimentary boundaries) and flight-line or levelling artefacts both produce RTP gradient ridges that are not faults.
